ocl:
context Patient
inv: self.isInsured implies self.insurance <> null

context Hospital
inv: (self.departments->any(x | x.name <> '') <> null) and (self.departments->size() = 3)

context Hospital
inv: self.wards->any(x | x.floor > 2) <> null

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 6 and self.totalAmount <= 65

context Invoice
inv: self.totalAmount >= 4 and self.totalAmount <= 6

context Doctor
inv: self.appointments->size() >= 1 and self.appointments->size() <= 2

context Department
inv: self.doctors->size() >= 1 and self.doctors->size() <= 1

context InsurancePolicy
inv: (self.patient.isInsured) and (self.validUntil.size() >= 6 implies self.validUntil.substring(1, 6) = 'AB')

context Department
inv: (self.nurses->one(x | x.shift <> '')) and (self.name <> '' and self.name.size() > 0)

context Prescription
inv: ((self.issuedAt <> '') and (self.medications->forAll(v | v.name <> ''))) and (self.medications->exists(v | not(v.name <> '')))

context Ward
inv: ((self.floor > 0) and (self.rooms->forAll(v | v.roomNo <> ''))) and (self.floor < -5)

context Bed
inv: ((self.isOccupied = false) and (self.bedNo.size() <= 22)) and (not((self.isOccupied = false) and (self.bedNo.size() <= 22)))

context Department
inv: (self.nurses->exists(x | x.nurseId <> '')) and (not(self.nurses->exists(x | x.nurseId <> '')))

context Patient
inv: ((self.isInsured = true) and (self.patientId <> '' and self.patientId.size() > 0)) and (not((self.isInsured = true) and (self.patientId <> '' and self.patientId.size() > 0)))

context Bed
inv: (((self.isOccupied = false) and (self.room.oclIsTypeOf(Room))) and (self.bedNo.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')) and (not(((self.isOccupied = false) and (self.room.oclIsTypeOf(Room))) and (self.bedNo.toUpperCase() = 'TEST')))

context Medication
inv: ((self.prescription.record.createdAt <> '') and (self.name.size() <= 85)) and (not((self.prescription.record.createdAt <> '') and (self.name.size() <= 85)))

context MedicalRecord
inv: (self.prescriptions->exists(x | x.issuedAt <> '')) and (not(self.prescriptions->exists(x | x.issuedAt <> '')))

context Department
inv: (self.doctors->forAll(x | x.specialty <> '')) and (self.doctors->exists(x | not(x.specialty <> '')))
